evidence.remote_allowed: This is a full-time, on-site Human Resources Manager role based in Singapore.
evidence.salary_frequency: per month (implied by range format and standard practice for this amount)
must_have_skills: Human resources operations and administration skills, including HR policy implementation, HRIS usage, and employee records management.
Talent acquisition and workforce planning capabilities, covering job design, recruitment, interviewing, and onboarding practices.
Employee relations and performance management skills, such as conflict resolution, feedback facilitation, and performance review coordination.
Knowledge of Singapore employment laws, statutory requirements, and HR compliance standards.
Ability to design and coordinate training, development, and career progression programs that support organizational growth.
Strong communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills
Proficiency in using productivity and collaboration tools (e.g., MS Office, HR software)
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field
nice_to_have_skills: relevant HR certifications (e.g., SHRM, CIPD) are an advantage.
Prior experience in an HR Manager or senior HR generalist role, preferably within technical, engineering, or professional services sectors.
evidence.seniority: Prior experience in an HR Manager or senior HR generalist role
evidence.education_required: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field
